## Blog posts

- [What Is the Google Knowledge Graph and How Does It Affect SEO?](https://dilbdrbk.com.np/blog/what-is-the-google-knowledge-graph/): Google's Knowledge Graph is a database of entity facts that feeds knowledge panels and entity matching, shaping SEO without being a listed ranking system.
- [How to Create a Topical Map](https://dilbdrbk.com.np/blog/how-to-create-a-topical-map/): To create a topical map, define the central entity, map its attributes, gather real queries, then test which deserve a page and link them core to outer.
- [How to Get Cited by ChatGPT, AI Overviews and AI Mode](https://dilbdrbk.com.np/blog/how-to-get-cited-by-chatgpt/): To get cited by ChatGPT, allow OAI-SearchBot, get indexed in Bing and Google, and answer each fan-out sub-question with sourced facts and clear entities.
- [Topical Authority vs Domain Authority: What Google Uses](https://dilbdrbk.com.np/blog/topical-authority-vs-domain-authority/): Topical authority is how deeply a site covers one subject, and domain authority is an SEO tool score built from backlinks that Google does not use.
- [Entity SEO vs Keyword SEO: What Changes and What Stays](https://dilbdrbk.com.np/blog/entity-seo-vs-keyword-seo/): Keyword SEO optimizes a page for the words people search, and entity SEO optimizes it for the things those words mean, so a current SEO strategy uses both.
- [What Is Entity SEO? A Practical Guide](https://dilbdrbk.com.np/blog/what-is-entity-seo/): Entity SEO optimizes a website so search engines identify its entities, such as people, places and products, and connect their attributes and relations.
